blocks.text: You are paying Harbor and Rye at www.harborrye.example.
The form wants the digits on the plastic, the month and year, and the short code on the back.
It does not ask for the sign-in secret of your bank site.
The host in the header is the shop you opened. The tag on Stoneground rye flour, 2 lb matches the amount due.
No sleeve is ticked. No repeat parcel is marked.
Returns are accepted within 30 days when the seal is still intact.
